column1: Role table
Conflicts of interest: author ≠ verifier
Role limit: a stage executor does not rebuild the pipeline
Start order — the parent in `backlog`
First action on any wakeup — `multica issue children`
First stage of a new repository — bootstrap
A stage barrier closes only on terminal statuses
What to do at every barrier
The code / mechanics stage barrier — green CI on the PR head
The round synthesis stage — separate, when the panel worked and the Reviewer died
A stage closed through `cancelled` without an explanation is not promoted
Hand-off record for a stage and executor reconciliation
Sequential acceptance: raise the next card only after the owner's `done`
One review round = one sub-issue
Every sub-issue is self-sufficient
Stage bodies are assembled from templates
The specification goes to audit BEFORE the executor
The round envelope — in the audit stage body BEFORE promotion
A backup executor in the body of every code stage
Composition of the code stage body
No subagents on the code stage
Verify mutations by running, not by prediction
The code stage report — five sections
Resuming work — only by mentioning the executor
A mention = a new run; mention only when a run is needed
One writing agent per tree
Merge and report
The specification rides in the commit
PR ↔ card link — the slug in the PR title; the card before the title
The card comment — the same action as the owner report
Intent lives in git, state — in the tracker
Parent metadata keys
The score line — the first line of the Reviewer report, checked character by character
The cycle closes only when two conditions hold at once
The findings registry — a card under the parent
Exception codes — exactly three, there are no others
Circuit breaker: three rounds without convergence — stop and the owner
Zero findings ≠ a clean result on a dead run
The closure comment lists the excepted rows
The audit subject — the whole diff, including text
Every round finds its own layer; give the reviewer the intent; reproduce a finding before fixing
An (agent, question) pair does not repeat two rounds in a row
One representative of a model family per round; the run table
Scorecard — a row per run, the round closure gate
The run model — only from `multica runtime usage`
The class is set before the promotion of stage 1
`hygiene` — one round each, no cycle until convergence
Limits table per class
`money`: in the first round the Reviewer must include the Architecture Auditor
`done` on the parent — the owner only
Scope change — the owner
`accepted-risk` and `spun-out` — the owner decision
Impact class in doubt — a question to the owner before stage 1
Two PRs for one defect — a technical verdict, not merging both
Escalation to the owner instead of curing with briefs
What not to do
Owner report: result, cost, question
layer 1: A status change does not raise a run; only a mention does
layer 1: `in_review` does not close the stage barrier
layer 1: A parent created not in `backlog` starts a second PM run
layer 1: The "→ done" line in the sub-issue body
layer 1: `done` is terminal and emits no events
layer 1: After `blocked` neither `todo` nor `backlog → todo` creates a task
layer 1: `cancelled` and unassigning the executor do not stop the run
layer 1: The barrier triggers on statuses, not on the presence of a report
layer 1: The run model is not stored in the task and is undeterminable from inside
layer 1: `multica skill update` overwrites without versions or rollback
layer 1: `daemon restarted while task was in flight` — the platform restarts on its own
layer 1: `2>&1` when parsing `--output json` makes a successful write look like a failure
layer 1: A long-lived `multica` process is the workspace daemon
